assignment_rule: Each opening has a P-vs-P seat-swapped control pair and a seat-swapped treatment pair. One per-opening seed and the identical opening prefix are shared across both arms. Treatment opponent is fixed across the two seat assignments. Seeded shuffle assigns 32 openings to initializer and 32 to T512.
decision_rule: Propose a larger data-generation run only if treatment yield is at least 1.15 times control yield under both identity schemes. If either control yield is zero or run accounting cannot be reconciled, pilot decision is inconclusive.

metric.cpu_denominator: sum of seat-swapped pair CPU, including evaluator/model setup and reaped native-probe child CPU; capped/incomplete games contribute CPU and zero accepted rows
metric.name: distinct accepted designated-P turn positions with more than 32 active stones per CPU-hour

opening_selection: first 64 rows of the public seed556 screen-0005 openings.jsonl, preserving source order
resume_contract: Each verified seat-swapped pair is committed atomically with exact assignment, both full game trajectories, retained P rows, and process/native-child/pair CPU accounting. Checkpoints bind the attempt number that produced them. Resume validates every committed file against the freeze assignment and replay before dispatch; committed pairs are skipped. Attempt history distinguishes dispatched from worker-started; earlier dispatch-only attempts remain preserved when a later retry succeeds, while a started attempt without a committed pair is unreconciled and makes the result inconclusive.
runtime_policy: Artifact sidecars: PUCT/exact-root hybrid, exact-root threshold 16, final-score-margin objective, highest legal prior then lowest move-index tie rule, exact-leaf solving disabled.
